s1.syndrome_frame: Tachyarrhythmia with abnormal cardiac structure and conduction
salient_findings: Fast heart rate with wide QRS complex tachycardia
Elevated troponin T and N-terminal pro-brain-type natriuretic peptide
key_facts: Patient in their 30s
No previous medical or family history
No chest pain, shortness of breath, vertigo, or dizziness
Vital signs: temperature 36.8°C, blood pressure 102/57 mm Hg, pulse rate 170 beats/min, respiratory rate 20 breaths/min
Normal physical examination except for fast heart rate
Troponin T 0.018 ng/mL
N-terminal pro-brain-type natriuretic peptide 1709 pg/mL
Mildly enlarged left atrium with diameter 34 mm
Normal left ventricle with end-diastolic diameter 46 mm and ejection fraction 72%
ECG showed wide QRS complex tachycardia, third-degree atrioventricular block, and atrial fibrillation
LMNA gene variant (p.Arg377Cys) identified

shortlist.label: Tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Prolonged tachycardia and mildly enlarged left atrium

shortlist.label: Arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Wide QRS complex tachycardia and abnormal cardiac structure

shortlist.label: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Normal left ventricle with high ejection fraction and abnormal ECG findings

raw.rationale: The presence of an LMNA gene variant (p.Arg377Cys) and the combination of wide QRS complex tachycardia, third-degree atrioventricular block, and atrial fibrillation on ECG are consistent with Lamin A/C cardiomyopathy, which is known for causing various arrhythmias and conduction abnormalities.

rejected.label: Atrial fibrillation
rejected.why: Atrial fibrillation is one of the ECG findings but does not explain the full spectrum of the patient's presentation, including the wide QRS complex tachycardia and third-degree atrioventricular block.

rejected.label: Tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: While the patient has tachycardia, the presence of an LMNA gene variant and the specific ECG findings point more towards a primary cardiomyopathy rather than one induced by tachycardia.

rejected.label: Arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: The echocardiography findings do not indicate significant right ventricular involvement, and the left ventricle is normal, making this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: There is no indication of left ventricular hypertrophy on the echocardiography results, which is a hallmark of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
